Hi Oliver — thanks for the data and the heads up.

Quick summary of what we see on our side: high concurrency from your API key starting 15:28 PT; a large number of short-lived spikes (sub-60s bursts) that pushed you over the configured per-key burst allowance. Our front-line throttle policy converted many of those requests into immediate 429s rather than smoothing them into a short buffer. That combined with routing to a lower-concurrency model variant produced the latency you observed.

Immediate ask: can you tell me if the promotional traffic pattern is expected to be sustained in the next hour? If not, I can push a temporary per-key burst increase for 1 hour and route you to a dedicated pool to clear the backlog. If it will be sustained, we should coordinate a durable change (increase sustained quota + adjust burst window) and a replay plan.

I'm looping in Rishi and Marissa to coordinate the mitigation and get you an ETA in the next 20 minutes.

— Laura

Team — forwarding outage from Acme Retail. Key points:
- Spike pattern: many ~10–40s short bursts (not a steady ramp) starting 15:28 PT.
- Customer seeing 429s and jumps in p95/p99 latency.
- Likely cause: per-key burst allowance too small for their promotion bursts + policy prioritized immediate hard throttle instead of short buffering for this route.

Immediate mitigation options we should consider (pick 2 fast):
1) Temporary per-key burst increase (+5000 req burst token) for 60 minutes and route to Dedicated pool.
2) Tune the token-bucket burst window from 1s to 30s for that key (smoother absorption).
3) Enable short-lived prioritized buffering for the route (30s max) to avoid immediate 429s.
4) Fallback model variant to a higher-throughput quantized variant (trade-off: some regen quality).

Acme wants an ETA and a quick fix. Please respond with who will do what — Rishi please own the immediate config change, Marissa take the customer comms and rollback window, Jonas confirm capacity on Dedicated pool and whether autoscale will catch this if we route traffic.

Original message included below.
